scope_change_triggers: Repeating the exact eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: All exact nine-term complex factorizations of K_lambda=XX^T+lambda*(X X_v^T-4e_v)e_v^T, for all 112 P112 columns v and all nonzero complex lambda; sharp separate COPY and COPY-power bounds.
scope_change_reason: Changes eight-term/all-pairs scope to a rank-nine completion altering all 52 free entries of one column. All nine factors vary; this is distinct from the single-entry full-factor theorem PR1591 and arbitrary-column GL3/GL4 restrictions.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether this full nine-factor family can improve the complete separate COPY-power bill at unchanged width, normalization and multiplicity; no other costs are credited as savings.
stop_rule: Stop at this uniform-column family; no arbitrary-amplitude column theorem, tenth term, full supplier or kappa claim.
evidence: All exact nine-factor uniform odd-column completions retain COPY64 and power 8*8^q. The all-nine-mixed branch has sharp COPY71 and power 8*8^q+7^q. Proof uses credited and independently replayed 57,232 puncture-character cases, 13,552 support pairings, 14 exact Q(i) fixtures/175,616 entries and a separate 37,632-entry integer compensation replay.
author: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, verification and writing; no independent human or proof-assistant review.
